status: EXPERIMENT - not a balance decision; requires Rich's approval before any value moves into verdant_v0_2.json
description: Smallest set of changes found that removes every deadlock reported by economy.engine.bootstrap, chosen to match the timeline in VERDANT_VERTICAL_SLICE_ECONOMY.md §18, so the honest model can expose the bottlenecks behind the deadlocks.

rationale.nutrient_washer.jobs: Growth Nutrient gates the first Stable, but every producer needs Adapted workers, which only Stables supply. §18.1 expects Dredge + Washer and 4 Nutrient before any Stable, so General staffing matches the doc's timeline.
rationale.clean_flow_node.jobs: Clean Flow gates the first Stable but needed Adapted workers (same loop).
rationale.waste_collector: Waste service gates the first Stable but came only from the Waste Digester (Fired Ceramic + Adapted). §13 names a 'Waste Collector/Digester' and §18.2 establishes Waste service at minute 12-25, before ceramics exist. A cheap collector is added; the Digester still provides the service too.
rationale.ceramic_kiln.jobs: §18.3 runs a Kiln before the first Symbiotic, but Kilns need Artisans, which only Symbiotic homes supply, and Symbiotic needs Health whose clinic costs Ceramic. Adapted staffing follows the doc's timeline.
rationale.detox_clinic.cost: Health gates Symbiotic, but the clinic cost Habitat Composite, made only by Artisans. Composite removed from the clinic cost.
rationale.memory_circle.jobs: Memory Enclave evolution needs Memory service; the Memory Circle needed Coordinators; only Memory Enclaves supply Coordinators. Artisans staff the Circle.
rationale.starting_state.inventory.repair_enzyme: Silicate Pit and Carbonate Cutter cost Repair Enzyme, and every Enzyme route needs Ceramic first, which needs Prepared Silica beyond the starting 2. Two starting Enzyme break the loop.
